description.en: Correct interpretation of ESD histopathology — low risk (curative), local risk, and high risk (non-curative) resection categories per ESGE Guideline definitions, including depth of invasion, LVI, tumour budding, and margin status.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for interpretation of esd specimen histopathology but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs interpretation of esd specimen histopathology independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches interpretation of esd specimen histopathology to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
